goal: Permit guarded lease renewal to retain existing historical superset object locks while validating current issue and PR writes and every collision
prohibited_actions: No claim or reviewer ref mutation
No database write or migration change
required_checks: node --test --test-name-pattern="claim renewal|expired claim renewal|historical superset renewal|renewal keeps quoted" scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.test.mjs
assumptions: The already-held extra table app.rolepermissions lock remains protected and is distinct from table app."RolePermissions"
The current issue and parsed PR writes must each be covered by the held claim
stop_conditions: Any proposal narrows an existing claim lock
Any current issue or parsed PR write is uncovered or collides with another claim or PR
